blocks.text: A1-05 · Demonstration ⁧هٰذَا، هٰذِهِ، ذٰلِكَ، تِلْكَ⁩
Lesson overview

"What is this?" "This is my passport" "My passport," "That window" is big ": with the demos indicate objects and people." These are four very short words, but they change structure depending on whether you say "this" is a book "or this book": the same distinction between phrase and syntagma of A1-04. It's the last unit on the module. A1.1; The next week, we have the module test.

rows: 6–7 hours · one week (week 19 of the calendar)

blocks.text: Materials This unit, Anki deck A1 (tag A1-05), voice synthesis scripts, real objects on the desk
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. use ⁧هٰذَا، هٰذِهِ، ذٰلِكَ، تِلْكَ⁩ second gender and distance;
2. distinguish ⁧هٰذَا كِتَابٌ⁩ This is a book from ⁧هٰذَا الكِتَابُ⁩ This book is the first book in the history of the world.
3. ask and answer  ? what is it? • who is it? ( ⁧مَا هٰذَا؟، مَنْ هٰذِهِ؟⁩ );
4. appoint and describe the objects of an office and a bag;
5. understand indications about objects in a slow dialogue.

2. The four forms

rows: Away from the point of view of the area

blocks.text: Graffia. In ⁧هٰذَا⁩ , ⁧هٰذِهِ⁩ and ⁧ذٰلِكَ⁩ the ā long is written with the short aliph above the consonant (L0-09); in texts without vowels it disappears: . ⁧هذا، هذه، ذلك⁩ Writing ⁧هاذا⁩ It is an error of spelling, even if it is pronounced like this. For people and things. ⁧هٰذَا⁩ and ⁧هٰذِهِ⁩ apply to objects and persons: ⁧هٰذَا لُوكَا⁩ This is Luke. ⁧هٰذِهِ سَلْمَى⁩ This is Salmā». To be recognized. For more people you use ⁧هٰؤُلَاءِ⁩ hāʾulāʾi These, these, and ⁧أُولٰئِكَ⁩ ulāʾika "Those" are the following: you will study them with the plural in A1-12. For things in the plural, in Arabic, we use the singular female ⁧هٰذِهِ⁩ ( A1-15).
3. Phrase or syntagma: where the article stands

rows: This is the book (what you were looking for).

blocks.text: . ⁧هٰذَا كِتَابِي⁩ demo + name with suffix = phrase This is my book.

Because that's how it works. The demonstration is already determined. If the following name is indeterminate, there is a jump of determination and then a sentence boundary (as in ⁧البَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ⁩ , A1-04). If the name has the article, demonstrative and name form a single block: this book is ". To say "this" is the book "with a determined predicate," it inserts ⁧هُوَ⁩ / ⁧هِيَ⁩ to mark the border. With the suffix, the demo goes later. This my book is said to be ⁧كِتَابِي هٰذَا⁩ , and this city of Milan ⁧مَدِينَةُ مِيلَانُو هٰذِهِ⁩ : when the name is determined by a suffix or by aiḍāfaThe demo follows him. Recognize him; you will actively use it in A2. With an adjective. ⁧هٰذِهِ السَّيَّارَةُ الجَدِيدَةُ⁩ This new car is not covered by this Regulation. ⁧هٰذِهِ السَّيَّارَةُ جَدِيدَةٌ⁩ This car is new. The rule of A1-04 It's still true after the demonstration.

6. Pronunciation

⁧ذ⁩ in ⁧ذٰلِكَ⁩ . It is the sound dental [ð] of L0-03: the tip of the tongue between the teeth. dālika with d is the typical error; zālika with z is the pronunciation of many dialects, to be recognized but not to be imitated in MSA. The ā of ⁧هٰذَا⁩ . The first vowel is long: hāḏā , haḏā . The second ā (final alife) often shortens in the quick talk before the article: hāḏa l-kitāb . The ligament with the article. ⁧هٰذَا الكِتَابُ⁩ It reads as one word: hāḏā l-kitāb , hāḏihi s-sayyāra , tilka n- nāfiḏa (solar letter). Don't say the a of the article. ⁧ح⁩ in ⁧حَاسُوب⁩ and ⁧حَقِيبَة⁩ . Deaf pharyngal fricative; keep it distinct from h of ⁧هٰذَا⁩ and ⁧هَاتِف⁩ : two words of unity for each.

13. Oral production

1. With real things. Put six items on the table, some neighbors and some far away. Show them one by one and say that what they are, then describe them with an adjective of A1-03 ( ⁧هٰذَا القَلَمُ جَدِيدٌ⁩ ).
2. I play with the tutor. The tutor asks ⁧مَا هٰذَا؟⁩ / ⁧مَنْ هٰذِهِ؟⁩ indicating objects and photos; You answer quickly. Then Turn the roles around.
3. Lost and found. Recite the dialog 2 with the tutor, changing objects in the bag.
